meta.title: 把这四步学会了 控场不再是难事
meta.title_en: Master These Four Steps and Stage Control Becomes Easy
meta.topic: 直播带货 · 控场四步曲

scenes.context: 控场四步曲：第一步动作、第二步眼神、第三步声音、第四步话术。这四步有了，就一定能控住场。语域：直播教学，框架总览。
sentences: 控场四步曲：动作、眼神、声音、话术。
The four-step stage control: action, eyes, voice, and scripts.
stage control（控场）
你把这四步做到，你就会有控场。
Nail these four steps and you'll own the stage.
own the stage（有控场）
只要这四步有了，就一定能控住场。
With these four in place, the room is yours.
the room is yours（控住场）
paraphrase: 控场 → stage control / command the room
四步曲 → four-step routine / the four moves
scenes.speak: The four-step stage control: action, eyes, voice, and scripts. Nail these four steps and you'll own the stage. With these four in place, the room is yours.

scenes.title_cn: 第一步动作 + 第二步眼神
scenes.title_en: Step One: Action and Step Two: Eyes
scenes.context: 每次控场的时候，动作靠近一下镜头，目的是引起用户的注意。主播的眼神不仅要坚定，而且要灵动。语域：直播教学，步骤讲解。
sentences: 动作靠近一下镜头，引起用户的注意。
Lean closer to the camera to grab attention.
grab attention（引起注意）
眼神不仅要坚定，而且要灵动。
Your eyes must be steady — and lively.
steady and lively（坚定且灵动）
靠近镜头，是控场的第一步。
Leaning into the lens is the first move of stage control.
the first move（第一步）
paraphrase: 坚定灵动 → steady and lively / firm yet bright
引起注意 → grab attention / draw the eye
scenes.speak: Lean closer to the camera to grab attention. Your eyes must be steady — and lively. Leaning into the lens is the first move of stage control.

scenes.title_en: Step Three: Slow the Voice Down
scenes.context: 想要控场，声音一定要慢下来。当你像机关枪一样哒哒哒的时候，用户就听不清了。重要的话慢慢讲，瞬间抓住用户的注意力。语域：直播教学，节奏讲解。
sentences: 声音一定要慢下来。
Your voice must slow way down.
slow way down（慢下来）
重要的话慢慢讲，抓住注意力。
Deliver the key line slowly to seize attention.
seize attention（抓住注意力）
像机关枪一样哒哒哒，用户听不清。
Rattling like a machine gun, viewers can't follow.
rattling like a machine gun（像机关枪）
paraphrase: 慢下来 → slow way down / ease the pace
scenes.speak: Your voice must slow way down. Deliver the key line slowly to seize attention. Rattling like a machine gun, viewers can't follow.

scenes.title_en: Step Four: Scripts and a Demo
scenes.context: 控场话术就一个点：第一个听、第二个看。重要的话之前都要控场，话才更深入人心。例如：人生中只买一支包，一定是我接下来这一支——黑金方包，非常大气，又高级又百搭又能装，又经典。看好了，不要眨眼睛。3 2 1 走。语域：直播教学，话术示范。
sentences: 控场话术就一个点：听，然后看。
The stage-control script is one thing: listen, then look.
listen, then look（听，然后看）
人生中只买一支包，一定是我这一支。
If you ever buy just one bag, it must be this one.
must be this one（一定是这一支）
看好了，不要眨眼睛，321走。
Watch closely — don't blink — 3, 2, 1, go.
don't blink（不要眨眼睛）
paraphrase: 深入人心 → land deeply / stick in the mind
land deeply · stick in the mind
不要眨眼睛 → don't blink / keep your eyes on it
don't blink · keep your eyes on it
scenes.speak: The stage-control script is one thing: listen, then look. If you ever buy just one bag, it must be this one. Watch closely — don't blink — 3, 2, 1, go.

pitfalls: Nail these four steps and you'll own the stage.

The eyes are firm and clever.

「重要的话慢慢讲」用 deliver the key line slowly。
shifts: 用 stage control（控场）、own the stage（掌控全场）、command the room（控住场）
用 grab attention（抓注意力）、seize attention（锁定注意力）、draw the eye（吸引视线）
用 scripts（话术）、the key line（重要的话）、lean into the lens（靠近镜头）
